CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.publishing_touch_credential_last_used(p_credential_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  UPDATE public.publishing_credentials
  SET last_used_at = clock_timestamp()
  WHERE id = p_credential_id
    AND (last_used_at IS NULL OR last_used_at < clock_timestamp() - interval '5 minutes')
$function$
